pages.title: Wave-Born
pages.text: The cloud-bank gangs. The Wave's own. The pirates the Charter files under $(l)"raid-class$()$(l), light-tonnage."$()$(br2)They come in small crews, in fast ships, in coats stitched from a dozen captured uniforms. They are not, individually, dangerous. They are dangerous because they outnumber the Charter's survey ships by something like three to one.

A Wave-born raid runs on a familiar timetable. They arrive at sunset. They take what they can carry. They leave before sunrise.$(br2)A fortified colony loses iron. An unfortified colony loses citizens. The Charter, after, files a survey docket and replaces the lost citizens with the audit reserve. Slowly.

Some Wave-born are former Charter Foremen whose dockets were recalled. The Charter, officially, does not comment on this.$(br2)Erik will, sober, tell you it is true. He will not, sober, tell you any of their names.
